pharmacology.text: 4-HO-EiBT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-ethyl-N-isobutyltryptamine or as eibucin, is a substituted tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, with an EC50 of 27.7 nM and an efficacy of 97.5%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is known mainly from laboratory studies of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
uses.zh: 它主要出現在血清素5-HT2A受體的實驗室研究中。
uses.zhHans: 它主要出现在血清素5-HT2A受体的实验室研究中。

fact.en: Short names for 4-hydroxy tryptamines, such as eibucin, miprocin and ethocin, are modelled on psilocin, the active compound of magic mushrooms.
fact.zh: 4-羥基色胺類的簡稱，例如eibucin、miprocin與ethocin，都是仿照迷幻蘑菇的活性成分psilocin（脫磷酸裸蓋菇素）來命名的。
fact.zhHans: 4-羟基色胺类的简称，例如eibucin、miprocin与ethocin，都是仿照迷幻蘑菇的活性成分psilocin（脱磷酸裸盖菇素）来命名的。
